Title: Azure SQL Database: General availability updates for late September 2021

Body.Content:
Azure SQL—generally available updates for late September 2021

In late September 2021, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Use SQL Data Sync Private Link to establish a secure connection between the sync service and your hub and member Azure SQL Databases
  • New server roles for Azure SQL Database enable Database management without admin-access
